changelog: - **Theme control returns to "system", plus a compact density mode** (#2078). `ThemeToggle` is now three-state (system → light → dark), `system` is a persisted cookie/localStorage value the no-flash script resolves via `matchMedia` (and follows live while the tab is open), and a new `DensityControl` sets `html.density-compact` — container-only spacing overrides in `globals.css`, so no tap target drops below 44x44px. Both are mirrored by selects on /account and persisted to the account (`User.density`).

en: The theme button now cycles System → Light → Dark, so you can hand the theme back to your device — and it follows a live system switch.
New compact density option tightens tables and lists without shrinking any button.
tr: Tema düğmesi artık Sistem → Açık → Koyu sırasıyla dönüyor; temayı cihazına geri bırakabilir, sistem değiştiğinde anında takip edebilirsin.
Yeni "sık" yoğunluk seçeneği, hiçbir düğmeyi küçültmeden tabloları ve listeleri sıkıştırıyor.
de: Die Theme-Schaltfläche wechselt jetzt System → Hell → Dunkel — du kannst das Theme wieder deinem Gerät überlassen, und ein Systemwechsel wird sofort übernommen.
Neue kompakte Dichte verdichtet Tabellen und Listen, ohne Schaltflächen zu verkleinern.
